summary: Round-2 re-validation: all 4 major and all 3 minor Round-1 findings are addressed. The three named regression tests (test_publish_retry_reuses_telegraph_url at tests/test_hw_review_publish_flow.py:158, test_publish_retry_after_teaser_exception at :205, test_move_to_published_rollback_on_error at tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py:623) are all verified to exist at the cited line numbers via grep. AC2 4-path coverage is now grounded in dominator-position semantics with an explicit positive assertion (transcreate_via_claude not called) plus T2 covering the line-1045 outage shortcut — sound logical proof that guard at line 985 fires BEFORE all 4 entry conditions. AC10 log marker is now asserted via assertLogs in T1 capturing INFO-level entry containing [idempotency-guard] and the link. Сценарий D (recurring stale row) is explicitly documented as out-of-scope in T7 with rationale (same code path activated K times, no new logic surface). T7 has explicit AC6 check, T1 has positive [idempotency-guard] log capture, T3 specifically asserts publish_article (Telegraph create) NOT called as differentiating regression surface. Mock target symbols (transcreate_via_claude, publish_article, outage_state.is_fallback_active) verified present in news_bot.py and existing test infrastructure. One residual minor nuance on T7's AC6 litmus strength is noted but does not block (status: passed under decision matrix).

findings.location: Section: Testing Strategy → Integration test T7; tech-spec.md line 181
findings.issue: T7's AC6 explicit check uses attempt_count=0 on the staged zombie row: 'zombie pending row's attempt_count was 0 before job(); after job() the row is gone (skipped), it never reached failed_articles (would require attempt_count=3)'. With attempt_count=0, even WITHOUT the guard fix, an IntegrityError on duplicate INSERT would only increment attempt_count to 1 — the row would NOT reach failed_articles either way. The assertion 'never reached failed_articles' therefore does not distinguish 'guard fired' from 'first IntegrityError strike, row stays pending'. This weakens the litmus value of the AC6 check vs. Round-1 recommendation #5 (which proposed pre-setting attempt_count=2, one strike away from failed). The check is now textually present (Round-1 finding addressed) but the assertion is logically weaker than it could be.
findings.recommendation: Strengthen T7 by pre-setting zombie row's attempt_count=2 via raw UPDATE before job(). Then the assertions become litmus-grade: with the guard, the row is removed from pending and link goes to processed_news (skip_pending path) — failed_articles stays at 0. WITHOUT the guard, the IntegrityError on duplicate publish would push attempt_count from 2 to 3 → slot loop's strike machinery would move the row to failed_articles. This makes 'failed_articles count = 0' an executable proof that the guard short-circuited the strike path. Cost: 1 line of raw UPDATE in test setup, 1 stronger assertion. Optional but recommended for AC6 confidence.
